The user wants UI strings in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage) for an app interface:
- s1: submit button for a feedback form (sends content to the team)
- s2: button in settings page to save/write changes
- s3: status text after changes are saved

Taiwan UI conventions:
- Feedback form submit button: 「送出」 or 「送出意見」. Common Taiwan usage: 「送出」. Since it sends to team, maybe 「送出意見」. Keep it simple: 「送出意見」 works well.
- Settings save button: Taiwan uses 「儲存變更」 or 「儲存設定」. "寫入" is less common; Taiwan typically says 「儲存」. So 「儲存變更」.
- Status text after save: Taiwan convention: 「變更已儲存」 or 「設定已儲存」. Avoid mainland phrases like 「已保存」. Taiwan: 「儲存」. So 「設定已儲存」 or 「變更已儲存」.

Output only JSON object with keys s1, s2, s3. No other text.</think>{
  "s1": "送出意見",
  "s2": "儲存變更",
  "s3": "變更已儲存"
}
